texts.li: [their:lowtech] {GIVER}, a hunter of {FACTION}, has sent a runner to warn the colony. {NAME}, a huge {KIND}, is coming down the valley toward the colony's land.
[their:hightech] {GIVER}, a hunter of {FACTION}, has radioed the colony with a warning. {NAME}, a huge {KIND}, is coming down the valley toward the colony's land.

li.label: Get ready
li.outcome: {FACTION} will tell the colony when {BEAST} is near.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will try to turn {BEAST} away themselves.

terms.li: {GIVER} asks the colony to be ready within {DAYS}: build at least {TRAPS} traps or {WALLS} lengths of wall or fence, and keep at least three in four of the colony's animals in a pen or a room.\n\nIf the colony agrees, the hunters keep watch, and {NAME} is expected to reach the colony's land some days after that. Being ready makes the fight easier, and {FACTION} will think better of the colony for it. If the colony stands well enough with {FACTION}, their hunters will come to help when {NAME} arrives. If the colony declines, the hunters will try to turn {NAME} away themselves.

accepted.li: The colony has {DAYS} to get ready for {NAME}: {TRAPS} traps or {WALLS} lengths of wall or fence, and the animals kept in.

reminder.li: The colony has {DAYS} left to get ready for {NAME}.

ends.li: [ready] The traps or walls are built and the colony's animals are kept in. {GIVER} says the colony is as ready as it can be. The hunters of {FACTION} are still watching for {NAME}.
[partly] The colony did part of what {GIVER} asked. The hunters of {FACTION} are still watching for {NAME}.
[unready] The colony did not get ready in time. The hunters of {FACTION} are still watching for {NAME}.

texts.li: Some days ago {GIVER} warned the colony that {NAME}, a huge {KIND}, was coming. The hunters of {FACTION} have now found a fresh kill at the edge of the colony's land, {WAY}, with large tracks leading to it.

li.label: Send someone
li.outcome: Someone of the colony will go and look at the kill.

terms.li: {GIVER} asks the colony to send someone to look at the kill within {DAYS}, to see how big {NAME} is and which way it is coming.\n\nIf someone goes, the colony will know which side {NAME} comes from. If nobody goes, it may come from any side.

accepted.li: The kill lies at the edge of the colony's land, {WAY}. Send someone to look at it within {DAYS}.

ends.li: [found] {A_nameDef} looked at the kill {WAY}. The tracks are huge, and they show that {NAME} will come from that side.
[missed] Nobody looked at the kill. The hunters of {FACTION} say {NAME} could come from any side.

texts.li: [!back,found] A few days ago the colony looked at {NAME}'s kill, {WAY}. Now the hunters of {FACTION} say {NAME} will reach the colony's land within a day, from that side.
[!back,!found] A few days ago the hunters of {FACTION} found {NAME}'s kill at the edge of the colony's land. Now they say {NAME}, the huge {KIND}, will reach the colony's land within a day.
[back] Last season {NAME} came to the colony's land and got away. The hunters of {FACTION} say it is coming back.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will try to turn {BEAST} away themselves.

terms.li: [help] If the colony takes this on, {NAME} comes within a day and attacks. {COUNT} hunters of {FACTION} come with it to fight beside the colony.\n\nIf {NAME} is killed, the colony keeps its body and a trophy from it, and {FACTION} will honour the colony. If it is badly hurt it runs away, and may come back next season. If the colony declines, the hunters will try to turn {NAME} away themselves.

[!help] If the colony takes this on, {NAME} comes within a day and attacks. {FACTION} will not send hunters to help, because the colony does not stand well enough with them.\n\nIf {NAME} is killed, the colony keeps its body and a trophy from it, and {FACTION} will honour the colony. If it is badly hurt it runs away, and may come back next season. If the colony declines, the hunters will try to turn {NAME} away themselves.

accepted.li: {NAME} will be here within a day. Get the colony's fighters ready.

notes.li: [came,help] {NAME}, a huge {KIND}, has come onto the colony's land {WAY} and is attacking. Hunters of {FACTION} have come with it to help.
[came,!help] {NAME}, a huge {KIND}, has come onto the colony's land {WAY} and is attacking.
[fled] {NAME} is badly hurt and running away.
[leaving] {NAME} has stopped attacking and is leaving the colony's land.

ends.li: [killed,!tamed] {NAME} is dead. The colony keeps its body and a trophy from it, and {FACTION} honour the colony for the kill.
[killed,tamed] {NAME} has been tamed and belongs to the colony now. {FACTION} honour the colony for it.
[driven,!last] {NAME} ran off badly hurt. The hunters of {FACTION} think it will come back next season.
[driven,last] {NAME} ran off badly hurt, and the hunters of {FACTION} think it will stay away now.
[left,!last] {NAME} left the colony's land. The hunters of {FACTION} think it will come back next season.
[left,last] {NAME} left the colony's land, and the hunters of {FACTION} think it will stay away now.
